Audit Trail — How It Works
COMPLIANCE & AUDIT
Audit Trail — How It Works
PURPOSE

The audit trail is an append-only, hash-chained log of every state-changing action in eCIgn.

WHEN TO USE IT

Whenever a surveyor, compliance officer, or counsel needs to reconstruct who did what, when, from where, on what document version.

SYSTEM BEHAVIOR
Every event row stores: event_id, prev_hash, hash = SHA-256(prev_hash | canonical(payload)), occurred_at_utc, actor (user_id, name, role, email, auth_method, mfa_verified_at), network (ip, user_agent, geo, device), subject (kind, id, document_version_id, document_hash), action, payload. Rows are inserted via POST /api/audit (internal) only; UPDATE/DELETE grants are revoked in production.
COMPLIANCE IMPACT

Satisfies HIPAA 164.312(b) audit controls and CMS 42 CFR § 484 survey reconstruction requirements.

EVIDENCE GENERATED

Every signing event, edit attempt, lock, void, export, and access denial is on the chain.

GUIDED UAT

0/6 operational checkpoints

Review operational posture
Open and execute tasks
Validate workflow timeline
Complete required forms
Upload and verify evidence
Run audit readiness pass
Keep checklist visible
